$comment: Required functionality and its verification status. Never delete a test to make the suite pass — fix the implementation. 'coveredBy' names the file that actually proves each item, so this file can be audited against the suite rather than taken on trust.

vitest.requires: PostgreSQL database `kiipmall_test` (TEST_DATABASE_URL, or DATABASE_URL with the database name swapped). The local database keeps its original name; it is configuration, not branding.

playwright.requires: A running app (the config starts `npm run dev` if nothing is listening) against the seeded development database
playwright.note: Set CHROMIUM_PATH to reuse a browser already on the machine instead of downloading one.

cases.name: money arithmetic never uses floating point
percentage (basis points) discounts round half-up deterministically
an amount splits across lines without losing or inventing a penny
zero-decimal currencies are formatted and parsed correctly
effective price prefers a valid sale price and ignores an invalid one
cart totals: subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total
free shipping threshold applies to the discounted subtotal
tax is charged on the discounted net, not the gross
expired, inactive, future and used-up coupons are rejected
minimum subtotal and max discount caps are enforced
scoped coupons only discount matching line items
order state machine allows declared transitions
order state machine rejects undeclared transitions
cancelled and refunded are terminal; nothing transitions to itself
role hierarchy grants the expected permissions, monotonically
customers are denied every admin permission
role management is reserved for the super administrator
Zod schemas reject malformed registration and address payloads
redirect targets that would leave the site are refused
rate limiter blocks after the configured burst and resets per window
rate limiter fails open rather than taking the site down
search query normalisation strips wildcards and control characters
the logger redacts secret-bearing keys at any depth

integration.requires: PostgreSQL test database — these assert row locks, CHECK constraints and transaction semantics, none of which exist in a mock

cases.name: reservation reduces available stock without moving physical stock
concurrent checkouts cannot oversell the last unit
cancelling an order releases its reservation
every stock change writes an inventory transaction
commit and release are idempotent
the database refuses negative stock even if the service is bypassed
a backorder variant may be reserved beyond stock
cart totals are recomputed from the database, not the client
anonymous cart merges into the user cart on sign-in, summing quantities once
placing an order creates it in PENDING_PAYMENT and reserves stock
an order cannot be created from another customer's basket or address
the coupon is re-validated at order time, not only when it was applied
every accepted transition writes a status event
webhook with a valid signature marks the order PAID
webhook with an invalid signature is rejected
replayed webhook events are idempotent
an event whose amount does not match the order is refused
a coupon redemption is counted once, on payment
partial and full refunds update payment, order totals and status
refunding more than was paid is refused
passwords are stored hashed and salted, never in plaintext
IDOR: a user cannot read another user's order
verified-purchase flag is derived from delivered orders
duplicate reviews per product per user are rejected at the database level
unmoderated reviews are hidden and excluded from the rating
admin mutations write an audit entry, with secrets scrubbed
slug generation is stable, ASCII and collision-safe per namespace
a second partial refund on an already partially refunded order succeeds
a later partial refund that settles the balance closes the order and returns stock
a refused refund leaves the totals and status untouched

login
product search
product variant selection updates price, SKU and availability
add to cart
wishlist add and remove
checkout requires authentication
payment test flow, including a decline that leaves the order recoverable
order confirmation
customer order history
admin login
admin product creation
admin inventory update
admin order status update
admin refund flow: partial refund, over-refund refused, second partial refund
unauthorised admin access is rejected
category browse, filter and sort, with shareable URLs
mobile navigation, filter sheet and no sideways scroll at 393px
keyboard-only navigation of the mega menu and basket drawer
coupon applies and is reflected in the order total
review moderation publishes and rejects
the payment webhook refuses unsigned and wrongly signed requests
security headers are present on every response
private areas are excluded from robots.txt and the sitemap
an open redirect in the next parameter is ignored
sign-in failures do not reveal whether an address is registered
zero axe WCAG 2.1/2.2 A+AA violations on eight storefront pages and the admin dashboard
prefers-reduced-motion is honoured; content renders in its final state
an order whose payment was declined offers no refund control
an archived product disappears from the storefront but stays in the back office
